properties.run_id: active run id or automation id
properties.source: self_review | reviewer | validation_failure | blocker | repeated_friction | user_correction
properties.category: project-local | global-prompt | global-validation | global-safety | release | documentation | performance
properties.problem: specific observed weakness, not a vague preference
properties.evidence: file, command, reviewer finding, validation result, or repeated event that supports the candidate
properties.target_files: files or config areas the candidate would touch
properties.validation: commands, checks, reviewer gates, and rollback evidence required before promotion
properties.notes: optional short rationale or rejection reason
